summary: Customer service platform for tickets, messaging, help center and support operations.
access_note: 14-day free trial; sponsored 5-agent instance only for Marketplace/developer partners. API tokens are created in Admin Center; docs now push OAuth and mark API tokens deprecated.
blocker_note: Multi-customer apps must use global OAuth, obtained via Marketplace registration/submission and the partner program; docs do not name a paid plan as the gate.
notes: Zendesk docs index (developer.zendesk.com/llms.txt) lists no general ticketing MCP server; a third-party blog (Sept 2026) says the only first-party one is a customer-facing ChatGPT channel EAP, so mcp stays community. Quote for api_styles is auth-page only; REST breadth inferred from the API reference. Auth page marks API tokens deprecated and asks existing customers to migrate to OAuth.

evidence.quote: Zendesk supports using OAuth access tokens to authenticate API requests.
API tokens are auto-generated passwords in the Zendesk Admin Center.

review.from: tldv blog quote about a first-party MCP launch
review.to: GitHub README quote for the community server
review.reason: The old quote described a customer-facing ChatGPT server and did not support the community-server claim; the README states the server exists.
Independent browser check disagreed; a blind browser ruling backed it. Zendesk publishes its own MCP server, so official, not none or community.
